summary: Flag Ship Acquisition Corp (SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting the mutual termination of its merger agreement with Great Future Technology Inc. dated April 18, 2025. The termination was effective May 3, 2026, by mutual consent. No termination fee is payable; the parties exchanged mutual releases except for knowing/intentional breach claims. The SPAC remains a blank-check company trading on Nasdaq (units FSHPU, shares FSHP, rights FSHPR). What to watch: Flag Ship must now pursue a new de-SPAC target within its remaining timeline or risk liquidation; no new timeline disclosed.
